# Service

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Service`](gmeow-Service.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Service>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)

A system that provides one or more functions — a web API, hosted application, or online service. A specialization of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md) in the schema.org / creative-work sense ([schema:Service](https://schema.org/Service)).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a system offering one or more functions as a creative-work artifact — a web API, hosted app, or online service ([schema:Service](https://schema.org/Service)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the organization that operates the service (that is a [`gmeow:Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md)) and for a one-off occurrence of using it (that is a [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md) / [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md)).

### How to use

- Type the service [`gmeow:Service`](gmeow-Service.md), give it [`gmeow:hasTitle`](../properties/gmeow-hasTitle.md) and an [`gmeow:identifier`](../properties/gmeow-identifier.md); link the operating organization as a separate [`gmeow:Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md) via the appropriate relator.

### Examples

- ex:api a [`gmeow:Service`](gmeow-Service.md); [`gmeow:hasTitle`](../properties/gmeow-hasTitle.md) ex:apiTitle.
